CHIEF COMPLAINT
Follow-up of chronic problems.

HISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS
Anna is a 44-year-old female with a past medical history significant for arthritis, gout, and reflux presenting for follow-up of her chronic problems. She reports her arthritis is getting better. She has been doing pilates and lifting weights to build muscle strength, and her joint pain has been improving. She completed physical therapy for her right knee and has rebuilt her strength. She is now able to walk one to one and a half miles daily. Regarding her gout, she had an episode of her right first big toe about two months ago. Medication helped it resolve and she is taking allopurinol with no issues and no further flare-ups. Regarding her reflux, she was placed on omeprazole and started dietary modifications, but has not completely cut out certain foods. She continues to have episodes and is experiencing vomiting in the mornings. She also reports abdominal pain and bloating. Her last bowel movement was two days ago and was normal with no blood. She denies weight loss, fever, or chills.

REVIEW OF SYSTEMS
Positive for nausea, vomiting, and abdominal distension. Negative for diarrhea, weight loss, fever, and chills.

PAST MEDICAL HISTORY
Arthritis, gout, and reflux.

MEDICATIONS
Omeprazole and allopurinol.

ALLERGIES
Not discussed.

FAMILY HISTORY
Not discussed.

SOCIAL HISTORY
Patient does pilates and lifts weights.

PHYSICAL EXAMINATION
Vital signs are stable. Cardiac exam: heart sounds good. Pulmonary exam: lungs sound good. Abdomen: pain to right upper quadrant on palpation, no rebound or guarding, no peritoneal signs. Right knee: shows some effusion, slight pain to palpation, and decreased range of motion.

RESULTS
Autoimmune panel: normal. Right knee x-ray: no fracture, shows residual arthritis.

ASSESSMENT AND PLAN
Reflux and nausea/vomiting: Order right upper quadrant ultrasound to rule out gallstones. Check labs. Continue omeprazole 40 mg once daily and continue dietary modifications.

Gout: Everything appears controlled. Continue allopurinol 100 mg once daily. Refill ordered.

Arthritis: Continue pilates and continue using the knee. Follow up if any issues arise for further imaging or intervention.
